articles.title: Oil, US Treasuries prop up Indian bonds
articles.description: Indian government bonds increased in early trading as oil prices declined, following a previous rally. The Brent crude price slipped significantly after hitting a six-month high last week, which impacted the debt market. Foreign investors have sold a substantial amount of Indian government debt since August, contributing to a prolonged rise in benchmark yields. Concerns over inflation and the Reserve Bank of India's rate decisions are influencing market sentiments.
